description: This file is a shell script that functions as a helper for launching diff and merge tools within Git, compatible with GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF. It manages prompts, external commands, and the execution flow for external diff and merge tools based on Git configuration.

methods.name: should_prompt
methods.description: Determines whether the user should be prompted before launching the diff/merge tool based on Git configuration.

methods.name: use_ext_cmd
methods.description: Checks if an external command was specified via GIT_DIFFTOOL_EXTCMD.

methods.name: launch_merge_tool
methods.description: Handles the process of prompting the user (if necessary) and launching the specified merge tool with the provided filenames.
